title: A/R Detail: money headers sort largest first
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: One aging bucket on A/R Detail holds three invoices with different amounts and open balances.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • In the "1-30 days past due" bucket there are three open invoices, {Document-A}, {Document-B} and {Document-C} for {Customer-C}, {Customer-A} and {Customer-B} in that order (in name order these customers read A, B, C): {Document-A} is dated 40 days ago, due 10 days ago, amount $300.00, open $50.00; {Document-B} is dated 20 days ago, due 20 days ago, amount $100.00, open $100.00; {Document-C} is dated 35 days ago, due 5 days ago, amount $200.00, open $150.00.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-09 Alder, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-09 Birch, {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-09 Cedar; {Document-A} is S1-101, {Document-B} is S1-99 and {Document-C} is S1-100 (the app assigns the real numbers; the dates and amounts are the ones that matter).
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with the "1-30 days past due" bucket expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Amount" header.
  2. Click the "Amount" header again.
  3. Click the "Open Balance" header.
  4. Click the "Open Balance" header again.
  5. Click the "Open Balance" header a third time.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: rows inside each aging bucket sort by Amount, largest first: {Document-A} $300.00, {Document-C} $200.00, {Document-B} $100.00.
  • Step 2: smallest first: {Document-B}, {Document-C}, {Document-A}.
  • Step 3: rows inside each aging bucket sort by Open Balance, largest first: {Document-C} $150.00, {Document-B} $100.00, {Document-A} $50.00.
  • Step 4: smallest first: {Document-A}, {Document-B}, {Document-C}.
  • Step 5: largest first again, as in step 3.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R1, A/R Detail columns: “A/R Detail: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, ID, Customer Full Name, Due Date, Amount, Open Balance.”
  • S2-R1: “Every column on all six reports sorts when its header is clicked, except A/P Unpaid Invoices' Vendor Name column (S2-N1). The columns are:”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
  • S2-R5: “On the grouped reports, a header click sorts the rows inside each group; the groups themselves never move (S1-R5, S1-R6).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p1-click-the-total-header.png: figure "Click the Total header" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"
  • ar-ap-p1-a-p-aging-detail-opens-by-vendor-name.png: figure "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"

The design's own words:

  • "First click gives the useful order: money largest first. Second click reverses, third repeats the first. S2-R1, S2-R2, S2-R3, S2-R7." (caption of "Click the Total header")
  • "Buckets stay in fixed order; rows inside each bucket go by vendor name (was most overdue first). S1-R5, S2-R4, S2-R5." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name")

Difference from the PRD (DD-06), closed: PRD version 5 said A/R Detail and A/R Collection headings written "Transaction type", "Customer full name", "Due date", "Past due", "Open balance" (S2-R1); the design shows the after pictures read "Transaction Type", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Past Due", "Open Balance"; today's production pictures already read the same, with "Location Full Name". Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 4): Title Case on all six reports, on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV, as the design shows; PRD version 9 adds S2-R4a and writes S2-R1 in Title Case. The design's version is now the requirement and this case follows PRD version 9; D-81 (C715563), held until then, is now a normal design case.
